test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 6th December 2021 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: If a certain sum with compound interest becomes 1(1)/(2) times in 4 years, then in how many years will the same sum become 2(1)/(4) times at the same rate of interest?
solution:
**Concept:**

Money compounds to equal values in an equal period of time at the same rate of interest.

Calculation:

According to the question, the amount becomes 3over2 times in 4 years.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0bacb70cb3dae9d54e852232236276859b845f156ea3d549178982ff372e0c65.png] 

Total time required = 4 + 4 = 8 years

∴ The total time required is 8 years.
